nodes.text:
According to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the HMPV belongs to the Pneumoviridae family, the same family as the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). 

It typically causes upper and lower respiratory infections, presenting symptoms similar to a common cold
